title: York County One Map
description:
One Map provides citizens of York County, South Carolina a report focused application to look up a property by address or parcel and obtain information beyond basic property details. 

After clicking on "Property Search" users can find more information in report form such as - Services/Utilities, Stormwater, Public Safety, Zoning, Political, School Attendance and Oblique/Streetview Imagery.

One Map is a place to find additional applications such as those that can find who a council representative may be, display infrastructure projects nearby, look up road ownership, and find schools assigned to an address.

For users interested in a map-focused option the One Map Viewer was created with VertiGIS Studio Web which allows users to launch and zoom to a selected feature.

The application makes use of Experience Builder and over 100 feature services (updated daily).  Both application and data are hosted in ArcGIS Online.  Many thematic web maps are used within the application, each having popups built using Arcade to display information designed by stakeholders from many business units and external agencies.
